name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt a 2px focus ring with 4.5:1 contrast and a 1px outer shadow at 3:1 contrast. This keeps the ring visible on all backgrounds while avoiding harsh edges that strain eyes. The trade-off is slightly thicker focus rings on high-contrast modes, but it ensures keyboard users never lose track of focus.

name: Reader
text: The 2px focus ring at 4.5:1 contrast still risks disappearing on patterned backgrounds with mid-tone colors. A 3px ring at 7:1 contrast on interactive elements solves this but may feel heavy. Test with a 10-person keyboard user group on live EXCAVA pages—if any fail to track focus, adopt the thicker ring.

name: Ramp
text:
Adopt a 3px focus ring at 7:1 contrast on interactive elements. This guarantees visibility on all backgrounds, including patterned and mid-tone surfaces, meeting WCAG 2.2 AA for focus indicators. The trade-off is a bolder ring that may feel heavier in minimalist designs, but it eliminates the risk of users losing focus. Test with 10 keyboard users on live EXCAVA pages—if no one reports issues, this becomes the standard.

name: Reader
text: The 3px ring at 7:1 contrast risks making EXCAVA look heavy-handed in minimalist views—especially on mobile where space is tight. Instead, test a 2px ring at 4.5:1 contrast with a 1px outer glow at 3:1 contrast; it’s lighter but still catches the eye on patterned backgrounds. Run the same 10-person keyboard user test—if anyone loses track of focus, default to the thicker ring.
